title: Resolution urging Albany to fund gender-affirming care access program
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, A.8841A/S.7924A, which would establish a gender-affirming care access program to support and increase access to gender-affirming care. It responds to federal actions restricting such care and to the discontinuation of some hospital-based gender-affirming care programs in New York City. The measure does not itself create City law but expresses the Council's support for the state legislation.
